video_title: Breaking Down How the KNICKS CAME BACK Against the Spurs in Game 4 | NBA FINALS

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: The game was meant for an OG Anunoby legacy performance
quotes.excerpt: The game was meant for an OG legacy game.
quotes.quote: The ball hit his last two fingers. He just swatted at it. The game was meant for an OG legacy game.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Everything is easier said than done and clear in hindsight
quotes.excerpt: Everything is always easier said than done. Everything is always very, very clear in hindsight.
quotes.quote: I will repeat this as long as we record this pod and as long as we record any other pods: Everything is always easier said than done. Everything is always very, very clear in hindsight.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Players need over 100 games in a year to handle the pressure
quotes.excerpt: You have to go through over 100 games of basketball in a year of life to even have a chance.
quotes.quote: You have to go through over 100 games of basketball in a year of life to even have a chance to be doing what you are doing now.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' second-half collapse was due to a fine line
quotes.excerpt: Everything that could go wrong for them in the second half went wrong.
quotes.quote: 30 points in the second half for San Antonio. Two halves. Everything that could go wrong for them in the second half went wrong. They did not shoot the ball well. They did not defend quite as well. A lot of people are going to say they were relaxed, which in a sense they did, but it was honestly too big of a lead where they just got a little bit tight, trying not to be tight, relaxed but trying. There is a fine line there.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' shooting percentages were not the only factor in the loss
quotes.excerpt: Basketball is a game of percentages. No matter how the runs in a game go.
quotes.quote: They shot 40% from three throughout the entire game. 17 of 43. If you smooth out the makes over the course of the 43 shots so that they are not front-loaded, 14 of them in the first half, it seems like their approach to the game would be different. In a sense, it did seem like they fell in love with it. Basketball is a game of percentages. No matter how the runs in a game go, when you look at the final box score, the Spurs shot 42% from the field and 40% from three, and the Knicks shot 46% from the field and 47% from three.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' aggressive play style was a double-edged sword
quotes.excerpt: If they stop playing aggressive, if they were to just hold the ball and sit on it.
quotes.quote: If they stop playing aggressive, if they were to just hold the ball and sit on it for 24 seconds and not do anything and turn it over or take a late clock because they are trying to milk the clock to milk their lead, then the sports media headlines would be saying, oh, the Spurs were playing not to lose and they were playing scared. You have to always stay aggressive no matter what. You have to.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs should have focused on clock management and paint scoring
quotes.excerpt: Work the shot clocks, get points in the paint.
quotes.quote: If I were to say anything, I would say work the shot clocks, get points in the paint, and yeah, you are not going to keep up the crazy scoring pace. It is almost like they tried to keep up that crazy scoring pace for too long.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby's defensive play was a matter of luck
quotes.excerpt: I do not want to sound like a hater by any means. OG played a phenomenal game.
quotes.quote: I do not want to sound like a hater by any means. OG played a phenomenal game and OG is a phenomenal player, but it is luck. It is not something you practice. He has the general skill and body awareness to know where the ball is and where the hoop is, but he kind of just swatted at the ball and hoped for the best.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson is a defensive menace
quotes.excerpt: He is a defensive menace. He is causing them problems on the defensive side of the ball.
quotes.quote: It is not just offensively. He is a defensive menace. He is causing them problems on the defensive side of the ball. So he is doing it on offense and defense.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's role is to create and make big shots
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson's role in these finals is to always create, always be able to make something.
quotes.quote: He is not supposed to be a highly efficient player in these finals. It is not his role. Let that be for the OGs and the Mikals. Let them be the high-efficiency players. Jalen Brunson's role in these finals is to always create, always be able to make something out of nothing, and to make big shots when they count down the stretch.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Players make split-second decisions under pressure
quotes.excerpt: He made a split-second decision. He made the decision in full stride.
quotes.quote: He made a split-second decision. He made the decision in full stride that the decision was to lay it up or to continue along around the circle and get fouled one second later and have to shoot two free throws. In his mind, he is either going to make this layup or have to shoot two free throws one or two seconds later.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Most NBA teams can come back from a 30-point deficit
quotes.excerpt: Most NBA teams down 30 can come back. It is just a matter of time.
quotes.quote: Most NBA teams down 30 can come back. It is just a matter of time. Are you going to give them 100 minutes of basketball or 20 minutes of basketball? Eventually, things are going to go your way and as an NBA team, these two teams are both very good teams. It is not like the Spurs are 30 points better than the Knicks. It is just not.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: The ability to erase a 30-point deficit is the big story
quotes.excerpt: The fact that they were able to erase a 30-point deficit in 20 minutes is the deal.
quotes.quote: The fact that they were able to erase a 30-point deficit in 20 minutes rather than 40 minutes of basketball is the big deal here.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Basketball is random and coaches cannot control everything
quotes.excerpt: Basketball is just random. Things happen that coaches cannot control, that players cannot control.
quotes.quote: Basketball is just random. Things happen that coaches cannot control, that players cannot control. You behave the way you do, you use your intelligence and your physical abilities and your skill to the best you can, and then hope for the best result. It does not always go your way sometimes, it does, sometimes it does not.

quotes.speaker: Cam Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks' coaching staff is managing the series well
quotes.excerpt: I think the Knicks' coaches are doing a really good job managing the series.
quotes.quote: I think the Knicks' coaches are doing a really good job managing the series. I think the Knicks have shown a lot of mental resolve and togetherness that is enough to take you over the top in an entire playoff run and especially in the finals.
